channel.title: On the Water - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from On the Water (onthewater.com)

item.title: Garmin Unveils 360-degree Sonar with Revolutionary Spy Pole - On The Water
item.description: Garmin's new 360-degree scanning sonar lets anglers see a birds-eye view of fish and structure in every direction around the boat in 2D and 3D views.

item.title: Two Opening Day Classics Collide in New Berkley Trout Lure - On The Water
item.description: The "Dough Rider" spinner from Berkley allows anglers to add Powerbait scent to an inline spinner.

item.title: OTW Angling Adventures Preview: The Beach Boys - Surfside Stripers - On The Water
item.description: Chris Megan and Neal Larsson connect with lifelong friends to chase stripers the old-school way: on foot, in the waves, and from a 1970s Scout International, right in the strike zone of shoreline blitzes.

item.title: Black Sea Bass Limits Just Increased: Here's What Your State Gets in 2026 - On The Water
item.description: Good news for Northeast anglers: the Atlantic States Marine Fisheries Commission (ASMFC) has approved up to a 20% increase in the black sea bass harvest for 2026.

item.title: Mustang Survival: Gear Built for Serious Anglers - On The Water
item.description: Mustang Survival gear gives anglers the confidence to focus on fishing while staying and comfortably protected on the water.

item.title: OTW Angling Adventures Preview: The Ghosts of the Jersey Coast with Gene Quigley - On The Water
item.description: Chris Megan and Jimmy Fee join Gene Quigley on the hunt for the "ghosts' of the Jersey Coast — giant bluefin tuna that appear and disappear in the blink of an eye.

item.title: The Truth About the Massachusetts Largemouth Record with Mark Burgess | OTW Podcast Ep. 76 - On The Water
item.description: Mark Burgess describes his efforts to track down the true story of the 15-pound Massachusetts largemouth bass record.

item.title: Striper Migration Map - March 20, 2026 - On The Water
item.description: It’s been a long, cold winter, with freezing temperatures lingering into mid-March, but the striped bass follow more cues than just the water temperature to begin their migrations.

item.title: New Bill Turns Chesapeake Bay's Blue Catfish into Pet Food
item.description: The U.S. House of Representatives recently passed the Mitigation Action & Watermen Support Act to fund the use of blue catfish for pet food.

item.title: Berkley's Lab Series Uses Scented "Slime" to Fool Pressured Bass - On The Water
item.description: For years, Berkley has designed soft baits around the premise that if you better understand how fish smell and taste, you can build baits that get more bites.
